abstract: We present a bridge from Modal Triplet Theory (MTT) to perturbative string theory. Starting from a ten-dimensional coherent fixed point (\mathcal{M}_{10},G_{MN},B_{MN},\Phi;A_{M}), we show: (i) a bounded worldsheet projection \Pi_{\mathrm{ws}} produces the Polyakov/RNS actions; (ii) vanishing worldsheet \beta–functions holds to the same order in \alpha' as the MTT string-frame action, yielding fixed point \Rightarrow conformal background to controlled order, up to local field redefinitions; (iii) Green–Schwarz anomaly cancellation and tadpole constraints follow from the MTT topological data with \alpha'/4 normalization and the torsional spin connection R_{+}; (iv) compactifications (Calabi–Yau and torsional SU(3)) and gauge bundles emerge from modal holonomy and curvature-gap dynamics; (v) T-duality is exact spectral equivalence on S^{1}, while S-duality is formulated as a modal-landscape conjecture. We record an AdS corner where a GKPW-type functional emerges at the fixed point
